Subject: Recap & POC next steps — NewLeaf Health

Hi Alex — great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed POC plan so we have alignment and clear owners. Attaching the POC requirements workbook and our standard POC template.

Summary of key business goals
- Reduce inference cost for clinical summarization pipeline by ~40% vs current hosted model.
- Meet 200ms 95th-percentile latency for the clinician web UI.
- Ensure all PHI stays in your VPC/private deployment and we can integrate with your KMS.

Proposed POC (3-4 weeks) — success criteria
1) Functionality: Redwood running on a dedicated private instance in your AWS account, integrated with your auth and S3.
2) Performance: 95th pctl latency <= 200ms for 1–2 concurrent clinician sessions (test harness included).
3) Cost: End-to-end token cost estimate with 30–40% savings vs baseline (sample tokenized workload required).
4) Security: SOC 2 evidence and network diagram review completed; KMS integration validated.

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + infra handoff (who owns infra: NewLeaf IT ops). Deliverables: access checklist + network info (see attached workbook).
- Week 1: Private deployment & model onboarding (Redwood infra + NewLeaf app owners).
- Week 2: Integration tests, performance tuning, generate perf report.
- Week 3: Joint review of success criteria, final recommendations, and next steps for production rollout.

RACI / ownership (initial)
- IT / Infra (Responsible): NewLeaf IT ops (Priya Sharma) — VPC, network, KMS access
- App / Integration (Responsible): Alex Johnson / Product team — API integration and test harness
- Security (Consulted): Redwood security (Dev Patel) — SOC2 evidence, network review
- Sales / Project management (Accountable): Marissa Cole — timeline, deliverables, escalation
- Procurement (Informed): NewLeaf procurement lead — commercial and SOW coordination

Immediate next steps (action items)
- Alex: Share infra contact and the S3/KMS access details (by Wed 4/1).
- Priya (or IT contact): Confirm a time for network review call next week.
- Rachel (SE): I'll loop you in to schedule the technical kickoff.
- Dev: please flag any immediate blockers on evidence we should surface.

Attachments: newleaf_poc_requirements.xlsx, redwood_poc_template.pdf

Thanks — excited to get this running.

Best,
Marissa Cole
